raw_feedback_text: The plotted ILT-Z concept did not clearly label P/S connections between connector and top frame, showed branch valve and branch connector as 3 t star point masses, omitted the visible branch-valve body, showed an unnecessary circular connector node, anchored the GD-ST label at the frame centre, used an X at the tee junction, and did not label the probable high-strain location requested by the query.

structured_feedback.affected_requirement: All ILS plots must show engineering-review symbols and requested strain-location markers clearly.
structured_feedback.affected_function: deterministic plot rendering and plot QA
structured_feedback.affected_behavior: draw branch valves as valve bodies, draw branch/top-frame and structure connector labels as visible F/P/S/D connection labels, avoid point-mass star labels for branch valve/connector, avoid extra connector circular node symbols, anchor GD-ST label to the top edge, show tee as a regular node, and show probable high-strain marker when requested
structured_feedback.affected_constraint: Human-readable plot must expose connection semantics and requested strain-watch locations without confusing analysis artifacts for components.
structured_feedback.pmap_issue: The prior plot carried some machine information but failed the human-review representation expected for paper and expert review.
